intent.outcome: Outdated panel only runs brew outdated once on demand or after TTL; request coalescing prevents duplicate concurrent calls; lazy load defers the call until the panel is shown.

problem.description: Bkp M25 marked Planned; not implemented in wip. Without this, multiple navigation actions trigger multiple brew outdated calls and the panel is slow on cold start.

in_scope: M25.1 Single-call invariant: brew outdated runs at most once per TTL window
M25.2 Request coalescing: concurrent callers share one in-flight result
M25.3 Lazy load: call deferred until Outdated panel is selected

acceptance_criteria.description: Calling refresh twice within TTL window results in one brew outdated invocation.
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: go test -run TestOutdatedCoalescing ./internal/brew/... shows 1 call recorded

acceptance_criteria.description: Outdated panel does not call brew outdated until first time the panel is selected.
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: go test -run TestOutdatedLazyLoad ./internal/gui/... shows 0 calls before panel select
